_note: Hardware Menu (manual L1665-L1748). Plan open-question #2 (ANSWERED 2026-10-11): the five DOS-only rows — Graphics Mode (L1686-L1698), Bios Keyboard (L1699-L1706), Small Memory (L1708-L1714), Pointer (L1721-L1732), Mouse Rate (L1734-L1737) — are OMITTED as anachronisms; documented here so the omission is visible, never silent. Ranges/defaults verbatim from the manual. W3-A (plan SE-COMPLETE-1012): both rows are WIRED — they route through settingsApply (typed se.settings store, validated 0..500 / 0..1000) and pace the sim in frame counts: firingDelay holds the director between requestFire and flight entry (manual L1739-L1744); fallingDelay holds the settle start (director settle clock + settle3d slump drain, manual L1746-L1748). UNSET = 0 steps = the pre-W3A behavior byte-identical (boot never pre-applies JSON defaults; the dialog defaults 100/10 apply only on APPLY).

firingDelay.label: Firing Delay
firingDelay.description: How long the computer takes to draw projectiles when fired. High = suspenseful/slow, low = fast.

fallingDelay.label: Falling Delay
fallingDelay.description: How fast tanks fall on screen. Set to zero to not wait.
